title: Three model additions across text and speech
summary:
Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite, LongCat 2.0, and CSM speech joined the models, while basic Grok images moved to 2K and Polli learned a few better habits.

Gemini Flash Lite moved to 3.5, including the fast search model, while existing aliases remain. LongCat 2.0 adds a 1,048,576-token context window, reasoning controls, and function tools. CSM 1B adds text-to-speech with six Sesame voices and five output formats; the audio docs now list its voices and formats, and the catalog has more model brand logos.

Basic Grok Imagine image generation and editing now request 2K resolution. Grok Imagine Pro image and Grok Video Pro requests moved to OpenRouter; Video Pro retains its existing clip options but now rejects fractional durations and has a three-minute polling limit.

Polli now renders Mermaid fences inline, handles Discord mentions and X links more reliably, and avoids repeating identical tool calls. Its prompt and GitHub actions were also tightened, with restricted actions hidden from non-admins.

daily.title: Gemini Flash Lite 3.5
daily.text: Use `gemini-flash-lite-3.5` for multimodal input, tools, structured output, reasoning, and streaming. Fast search also moved to Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-flash-lite-3.5).

daily.title: LongCat 2.0 joins
daily.text: Try `longcat` with a 1,048,576-token context window, reasoning controls, and function tools. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=longcat).

daily.title: CSM speech with six voices
daily.text: Generate speech with `csm-1b` using six Sesame voices and choose mp3, opus, flac, wav, or pcm output. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=csm-1b).

daily.title: Grok Imagine goes 2K
daily.text: Basic `grok-imagine-image` now requests 2K resolution for both image generation and editing. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=grok-imagine-image).
